did.abstract: This collection contains materials created by Vassar College Office of Communications and its various predecessors, such as the Office of Public Relations, News Office, Press and Information Office, and Office of College Relations. Records include internal and external correspondence; memos; press releases; subject files; notes; reports; drafts and final copies of various publications, from invitation cards to print journals; press and event photographs, including prints, contact sheets, slides, and negatives; video and audio recordings of college events; video material created by the Office of Communications; and extensive collections of clippings and other news reporting on Vassar College.

bioghist.head: Administrative History
bioghist.p: Established in 1915 as the Vassar College Bureau of Publication, this office and its various iterations was created to manage the college's internal and external communications, including press releases, newsletters, informational pamphlets, marketing materials, and various other forms of print--and eventually audiovisual and electronic--media.

head.emph: Chronology of Office Names and Divisions, 1915-2026

list.item: 1915 - Office established as the Bureau of Publication with Burges Johnson as director
1940 - Office name changed to Bureau of Public Relations
1947 - Office name changed to Office of Public Relations
1960 - A "News Office" is established under the Office of Public Relations
1970 - The News Office becomes an independent office
1977-1980 - The Office of Public Relations and News Office are temporarily combined into the Office of Communications
1981 - The News Office become the Press and Information Office
1981 - The Office of Public Relations becomes the Publications Office
1986 - The Publications Office is incorporated into the Press and Information Office
1989 - The office name is changed to the Office of College Relations
2010 - The office name is changed to the Office of Communications

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content Note
scopecontent.p: This collection contains materials created by Vassar College Office of Communications and its various predecessors, such as the News Office, Publications Office, and Office of College Relations. Materials are often closely related to operations of the Office of the President, as the primary function of the Office of Communications has been to communicate college activities and decisions to both internal and external audiences. Records include internal and external correspondence; memos; press releases; subject files; notes; reports; drafts and final copies of various publications, from invitation cards to print journals; press and event photographs, including prints, contact sheets, and negatives; video and audio recordings of college events; video material created by the Office of Communications; and extensive collections of clippings and other news reporting on Vassar College. A significant part of the collection consists of records kept and photos taken by Dixie M. Sheridan, who was a photographer for the Office of College Relations, Press Secretary (1980-1988), Assistant to the President (1980-1984), and Vice President for College Relations (1988-1994).

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Organized into five series: Series I. Administrative Files, 1929-2019; Series II. Photographic Material, circa 1917-2007; Series III. Audiovisual Material, 1978-2008; Series IV. Publication Samples, 1954-2020; and Series V. Scrapbooks and Clippings, 1941-2010.

accessrestrict.head: Access
accessrestrict.p: Some materials in this collection are restricted, including: student records, personnel records, and records related to the activities of the trustees, president, and financial administration of the college after 1985. Some files may have restrictions lifted pending review by the College Archivist. The remainder of the collection is open for research according to the regulations of the Vassar College Archives and Special Collections Library without any additional restrictions.

userestrict.head: Restrictions on Use
userestrict.p: Permission to quote (publish) from unpublished or previously published material must be obtained as described in the regulations of the Vassar College Archives and Special Collections Library .

did.unittitle: Subseries 1.2 - Office of Public Relations Files,

scopecontent.p: >Correspondence, budget documentation, internal memoranda, clippings, press releases, subject files, meeting minutes, notes, reports, and policy documentation generated by the Vassar College Office of Public Relations (also referred to as the Office of Publications). Also includes three copies of This Acre of Consecrated Brick, an album containing text and line drawings regarding the proposed renovations to the Main Building which were completed in 1959.

arrangement.p: Arranged roughly alphabetically in three groupings.

did.unittitle: Subseries 1.4 - Press and Information Office Files,

scopecontent.p: >Correspondence, budget documentation, internal memoranda, clippings, press releases, publication production files, cost sheets, subject files, meeting minutes, notes, reports, and policy documentation generated by the Vassar College Office of Press and Information and its predecessor office, the Office of Communications (1977-1979).

Correspondence to and from Dixie M. Sheridan (VP of College Relations, 1989-1994, and Secretary to the President, among other roles), copies of presidential speeches and addresses, biographical information about Vassar presidents, budgets, reports, internal memoranda, and press inquiries.

arrangement.p: Arranged roughly according to original order.

did.unittitle: Subseries 1.6 - Office of College Relations Files,

scopecontent.p: Correspondence, subject files, event files, letters and inaugurals from President Frances Fergusson, clippings, financial records, press releases, and other documentation generated by the Vassar College Office of College Relations.
Subject files, alumnae/i files, correspondence, clippings, and program files created by the Vassar College Office of Communications.

arrangement.p: Arranged roughly according to original order.

scopecontent.p: Photographic prints, negatives, contact sheets, and slides capturing campus events, scenes, and figures, presumed to have been created for use of the office for publications and promotion. Photo credits are generally provided on Folder titles or on the collection items themselves.
Photographs taken by Dixie M. Sheridan, Vice President for College Relations.
Photographs by various photographers, capturing Vassar College campus, events, and figures. Folders are titled largely by subject (e.g. person, event, or building), by photographer, or by date.

arrangement.p: Arranged chronologically by earliest file date.

scopecontent.p: VHS, Betacam tapes, slide carousels, reel-to-reel, and U-matic tapes depicting campus events, promotional video and slide shows, lectures, and other aspects of campus life. See item-level inventory for more information.
Working files and final copies of posters, fliers, invitations, fundraising campaign material, admissions material, and other publications produced by Communications
Production samples or proofs, printing instructions, and related material housed in envelopes with printing specifications marked on the exterior.
Copies of admissions brochures, Vassar Views, event programs, academic schedules, and other publications produced by the offices under their various names.
News clippings about Vassar College and/or alumnae/i from local and national news sources. Some scrapbooks focus on the Powerhouse Theater.
